do.text: Give each grip an `aria-label` naming its item: screen readers and the move announcements read it.

dont.text: Don't leave grips unlabelled: screen readers hear only “button”.

title: Keep the grip easy to hit

do.text: Keep the handle's target at least 24 by 24 pixels.

dont.text: Don't shrink the handle below what a pointer or a finger can hit.
